data.one_liner: Generate TOTP/HOTP codes per RFC6238/4226 with Base32 secrets and optional Google Auth mode.
data.what_it_does: This library provides functions to generate time‑based and counter‑based one‑time passwords. It supports SHA‑256/512 algorithms, Google Authenticator compatibility, and exposes utilities like remainingSeconds and constant‑time verification.
use_when: Implementing 2FA or OTP verification in a Flutter app
Generating codes for Google Authenticator or similar apps
Testing OTP logic in unit tests
avoid_when: You need a full authentication flow with user management
Your secrets are not Base32 and you prefer not to convert them
strengths: Supports SHA‑256/512 and Google Auth mode
weaknesses: constantTimeVerification may not be fully reliable
